cases.spec_ref: `registry.abbreviations()` with no arguments: the fallback edition in the default (flat) shape. Each surface's own defaults are what is compared, so a surface that defaulted to a different edition or shape splits here (#1014).

The flat standard abbreviation list for 4.1.1 — `[{heading, code, description}]` ordered by heading then code, built by the shared `dict::abbreviations_dto`. Python and Node each parse that builder's JSON; this pins that what each hands back is the builder's value, row for row (#1014).
The nested shape — `{heading: [{code, description}]}` — of the same 4.1.1 list (#1014).
4.2 differs from 4.1.1 in which codes it carries and in some descriptions (per-edition overrides); the surfaces must agree on the 4.2 list too, not only on one edition (#1014).
